items.title: 32.14 Safety Measures and Precautions (hifazat ke qadam aur ehtiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.14 with Quick Check 32.3 answered, printed pages 240-241 (PDF 243-244).

blocks.text: Industrial chemical facilities (chemical karkhanon) mein accidents (hadsaat) rokne aur workers (kaam karne walon) aur environment (mahol) ki hifazat ke liye sakht safety measures zaroori hain. In mein yeh shamil hain:

items: Workers personal protective equipment (PPE, apni hifazat ka saman) jaise gloves (dastane), goggles (hifazati chashme), helmets, lab coats aur protective shoes (hifazati joote) pehnein, taake chemicals, garmi ya harmful fumes (nuqsan deh dhuen) se chot na lage.

Chemicals par sahi label lage hon, aur unhein un ki properties (khasiyaton) ke mutabiq handle (sambhala) aur store (rakha) kiya jaye. Flammable (jaldi aag pakarne wale), toxic (zehreele) ya corrosive (cheezon ko gala dene wale) chemicals suitable containers (munasib dabbon) aur alag storage areas mein rakhe jayein, taake leaks (rasaao), spills (girna), contamination (milawat) ya khatarnak reactions na hon.

Industries ke paas aag, chemical spills, gas leaks ya explosions (dhamakon) ko handle karne ke clear emergency plans hon. Emergency exits (hangami darwaze), fire extinguishers (aag bujhane ke cylinder), first-aid kits aur spill control materials (gire hue chemicals sambhalne ka saman) maujood hon, aur workers jaante hon ke emergency mein kya karna hai.

Kaam ki jagah se zehreeli gases, dhuan aur gard nikaalne ke liye achha ventilation system (hawa aane jaane ka system) zaroori hai. Proper airflow (hawa ka sahi bahao) nuqsan deh cheezein saans mein jaane ka khatra kam karta hai aur kaam ka mahol mehfooz aur sehatmand rakhta hai.

Workers ko hazardous materials (khatarnak cheezein) sambhalne aur equipment chalane ki sahi safety training milni chahiye. Machines, pipelines aur storage tanks ki regular inspection (ba-qaida jaanch) aur maintenance (dekh bhaal) se faults (kharabiyan) jaldi pakre jaate hain aur industrial accidents ka khatra kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Pakistan ki economy ke (agriculture ke ilawa) do bare sectors batayein jo chemical industry par bohat depend karte hain, aur har aik ke liye aik zaroori chemical product batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Textiles (kapra): caustic soda (saath mein synthetic dyes aur hydrogen peroxide). Construction (tameerat): cement.
(Petrochemicals/energy sector bhi sahi jawab hai: crude oil se fuels.)

blocks.prompt: b) Crude oil ko alag karne wale process ka physical principle (usool) (intermolecular forces aur boiling points ke lihaz se) samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Fractional distillation hydrocarbons ko boiling point ke farq se alag karti hai. Bare molecules mein intermolecular (London dispersion) forces zyada taqatwar hoti hain, is liye un ke boiling points zyada hote hain aur woh column mein neeche hi condense ho jaate hain; chhote molecules oopar ja kar condense hote hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Bohat se cosmetics aur perfumes mein esters hote hain. Ester banane ke liye do qisam ke reactants aur aam catalyst batayein.
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acid aur alcohol; aam catalyst concentrated (garha) sulphuric acid hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Samjhayein ke concentrated HNO₃ jaise tez oxidizing chemicals ko ethanol jaise jaldi aag pakarne wale organic chemicals se alag kyun rakha jaye.
blocks.explanation: Oxidizing agent aag pakarne wale organic compound se tez aur bohat exothermic redox reaction kar sakta hai; dono mil jayein (maslan gir jaane par) to aag ya dhamaka ho sakta hai.

items: Safety: PPE pehnna; sahi label aur alag storage; emergency plans; achha ventilation; training aur maintenance.
